title: How To Get Rich In MLM And Direct Sales
summary: A former MLM distributor turned coach says MLM wealth comes from becoming an influencer who recruits leaders, treats the MLM company as a vendor, and claims anyone can hit a few thousand a month of passive income within a year.

assertions.quote: You can't become a network marketing millionaire if you can't recruit people who sell products, who also sell the opportunity.

verdicts.note: Regulator complaints and company income disclosures consistently show top MLM earnings are tied to downline volume rather than retail sales.

assertions.quote: network marketing is just like the the margins are too small for me.

verdicts.note: Per-unit margins are modest after required purchases and upline cuts, but the bigger problem is that most distributors sell little product at all.
Taylor notes MLM front-line distributors get usually under 10% commission on product sales versus 20-50% in ordinary direct sales, so recruiting a downline is vital to any significant income.

assertions.quote: The company can terminate the distributor at any time for any reason without notice.

verdicts.note: Standard MLM distributor agreements include at-will termination and the company owns the customer and downline data.

assertions.quote: they were on my email list before they ever came became a distributor for that company

verdicts.note: Owning an audience does reduce dependence on one vendor, but it mostly shifts the business to selling courses and books rather than making the MLM itself pay.

assertions.quote: Many of the people who need money, they want it the least. And the people who don't need the money want it the most.

verdicts.note: Recruits with existing networks and capital do outperform, but the claim mostly describes who survives the attrition rather than a mechanism that helps recruits.

assertions.quote: not a person watching this YouTube video right now who couldn't get to $5,000 a month passive cash flow by the end of this year

verdicts.note: MLM income disclosures and small-business survival data show the large majority of people who try earn little or nothing in the first year.
Empire advertised '$4k-$6k consistently monthly net profit' from its passive stores; the FTC alleges most clients lost money and virtually none made the advertised amounts.

assertions.quote: Anything you do that brings in a passive $5,000 a month is the equivalent to having a million dollar invested at 6%.

verdicts.note: The arithmetic holds but the equivalence ignores that business cash flow is riskier, less durable and less transferable than invested capital.

assertions.quote: When I become an author, I become an authority.

verdicts.note: Perceived authority does raise conversion in sales, but self-published books rarely sell and the effect depends on reaching an audience first.

assertions.quote: People don't get to the millions because they don't do the math. Not because it's so hard.

verdicts.note: This is a motivational framing; goal arithmetic is trivial and the difficulty lies in customer acquisition and retention, which the framing waves away.
